content.title: St. John's College | Liberal Arts College with a World-Class Faculty
content.text: St. John’s is a community of 1,000 students engaged in the rigorous exploration of great books and enduring ideas. Across philosophy, literature, the sciences, and more, students and faculty learn together by reading real books, asking deep questions, and pursuing truth for its own sake. St. John’s offers an education that is both timeless and timely. Instead of hiding behind screens and lectures, students engage with the books and each other to uncover a shared humanity and an intellectual fearlessness—qualities that serve them in college, life, and career. Undergraduate Curriculum Our students read the original writings of great thinkers across 3,000 years of history, engage in vigorous classroom discussion with fewer than 20 students around the seminar table, and study ideas across the humanities and sciences. Every student receives an interdisciplinary degree in the liberal arts. Our graduate programs are also books- and discussion-based. Faculty discuss their favorite books. Faculty describe seminar, the heart of St. John’s. #6 Professors Get High Marks (Princeton Review) 7:1 Student-to-faculty ratio 16 Average class size (no class larger than 21) #21 Best Undergraduate Teaching (U.S. News) From Pulitzer Prize, National Book Award, and Academy Award nominees to New York Times best sellers and O. Henry Award winners, Books by Johnnies showcases over 1000 books and dramatic works written by St. John’s alumni and faculty.
